_comment: Credit-card statement: purchases INCREASE the outstanding balance, payments DECREASE it. This is the inverse of a cheque/savings account. A R500 purchase should be -500 (expense) but the balance goes UP by 500, so a naive chain audit sees delta=+500 and 'corrects' the parser's -500 to +500. Column layout: Date | Description | Amount | Balance, with header-anchored generic parser. Balance chain: 10000 → 10500 (purchase +500 to balance) → 10650 (purchase +150) → 10450 (payment -200 reduces balance) → 10799.99 (purchase +349.99).
